description: This PHP class implements a value formatter that retrieves the name of an Education entity by its ID, functioning as a strategy within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin system.

classes.name: FormatWithEducation
classes.description: A class implementing a value formatter strategy to convert an entity value (education ID) into its corresponding education name using the EducationService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the education name corresponding to the provided entity value (ID). Creates and uses EducationService if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Provides an instance of EducationService, creating one if it doesn't exist.
